en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snow-covered road lined with houses and telegraph poles on the left, and a fenced churchyard with leafless trees and a church whose steeple rises above the trees on the right. A solitary figure walks along the road in the distance. Printed caption text at the bottom reads "Parti ved kirken, Elverum." The overall style looks like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.
